# Emspaced

> Emspaced is a premium coworking space provider in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia with two locations — KL Sentral and KL Eco City. It offers flexible hot desks, dedicated desks, private offices, meeting rooms, virtual offices, IT solutions, accounting services, and HR management systems for freelancers, startups, and growing enterprises.

## Business Information
- Name: Emspaced
- Type: Coworking Space / Serviced Office / Business Centre
- Country: Malaysia
- Locations:
  - KL Sentral: Level 23A, Menara Allianz Sentral, 203, Jalan Tun Sambanthan, 50470 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
  - KL Eco City: Level 5, Mercu 3, Jalan Bangsar, KL Eco City, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Phone: +6 03-7890 0205
- Mobile: +6 012-2819553
- Website: https://jh27.LIFE/
